title: The Animal That Survived Space
description:
In 2007, the European Space Agency put dried-out tardigrades (water bears) outside a capsule in orbit, in open space. Most survived the vacuum, some even survived the Sun's raw UV, and the survivors went on to have babies back on Earth.

Sources: ESA, "Tiny animals survive exposure to space" (FOTON-M3, 2007); Jönsson et al., Current Biology (2008).
Narration is AI-generated text-to-speech and the pictures are AI-generated illustrations.
